# API reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:generate` from `packages/api-client/openapi.json`. Do not edit by hand; `pnpm check:docs` fails when this file is stale. -->

GraphGoblin API 0.1.0. Concepts, SSE, authentication, and error shapes are in [07 - API, streaming, and MCP](../07-api-and-streaming.md); the machine-readable document is served at `GET /openapi.json`. Every route needs a bearer API key when keys are required, except `/healthz`, `/version`, `/openapi.json`, `/docs`, and `/hooks/*`. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code`.

## loops

Loop definitions, drafts, versions.

| Method | Path                               | Summary                                                     | Parameters                                                          | Request body     | Responses |
| ------ | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------- |
| GET    | `/loops`                           | List loops                                                  | -                                                                   | -                | 200       |
| POST   | `/loops`                           | Create a loop with an initial draft version                 | -                                                                   | `{ definition }` | 201       |
| POST   | `/loops/import`                    | Create or update a loop from exported JSON                  | -                                                                   | `object`         | 201       |
| GET    | `/loops/{id}`                      | A loop with its current published version and draft         | `id`: string (path, required)                                       | -                | 200       |
| DELETE | `/loops/{id}`                      | Delete a loop that has no active runs                       | `id`: string (path, required)                                       | -                | 204       |
| PUT    | `/loops/{id}/draft`                | Save the draft definition (validated, may be unpublishable) | `id`: string (path, required), `if-match`: string (header)          | `{ definition }` | 200       |
| POST   | `/loops/{id}/validate`             | Validate a definition without saving it                     | `id`: string (path, required)                                       | `{ definition }` | 200       |
| POST   | `/loops/{id}/publish`              | Validate the draft and freeze it as a new version           | `id`: string (path, required)                                       | -                | 200       |
| GET    | `/loops/{id}/versions`             | Version history                                             | `id`: string (path, required)                                       | -                | 200       |
| GET    | `/loops/{id}/versions/{versionId}` | One version with its definition                             | `id`: string (path, required), `versionId`: string (path, required) | -                | 200       |
| GET    | `/loops/{id}/export`               | The definition as JSON for committing to a repository       | `draft`: string (query), `id`: string (path, required)              | -                | 200       |

## runs

Starting, observing, and controlling runs.

| Method | Path                                | Summary                                                                      | Parameters                                                                                                                       | Request body                                                   | Responses |
| ------ | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| POST   | `/loops/{id}/runs`                  | Start a run from a manual trigger                                            | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | `{ triggerNodeId?, input?, return?, versionId?, allowDraft? }` | 202       |
| GET    | `/runs`                             | List runs, newest first, filtered by loop, status, or parent                 | `loopId`: string (query), `status`: string (query), `parent`: string (query), `before`: string (query), `limit`: integer (query) | -                                                              | 200       |
| GET    | `/runs/{id}`                        | Run snapshot: status, current node, iteration, waiting spec, result, failure | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| GET    | `/runs/{id}/thread`                 | The current context thread                                                   | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| GET    | `/runs/{id}/events`                 | A page of events; with Accept: text/event-stream, a live SSE tail            | `after`: integer (query), `limit`: integer (query), `id`: string (path, required)                                                | -                                                              | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/cancel`                 | Cancel a run                                                                 | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/pause`                  | Pause a run                                                                  | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/resume`                 | Resume a run                                                                 | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/input`                  | Answer a wait node in input mode                                             | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | `{ input }`                                                    | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/signals/{name}`         | Deliver a named signal                                                       | `id`: string (path, required), `name`: string (path, required)                                                                   | `{ payload? }`                                                 | 200       |
| POST   | `/runs/{id}/replay`                 | Fork a new run at a node, with the thread as it was just before that node    | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | `{ nodeId }`                                                   | 202       |
| GET    | `/runs/{id}/sessions`               | Harness sessions the run started or resumed                                  | `id`: string (path, required)                                                                                                    | -                                                              | 200       |
| GET    | `/runs/{id}/artifacts/{artifactId}` | Download an artifact from the run's thread                                   | `id`: string (path, required), `artifactId`: string (path, required)                                                             | -                                                              | 200       |

## settings

Owner settings and the model catalog.

| Method | Path                               | Summary                          | Parameters                                                           | Request body                                        | Responses |
| ------ | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| GET    | `/settings`                        | Owner settings                   | -                                                                    | -                                                   | 200       |
| PUT    | `/settings`                        | Update owner settings            | -                                                                    | `object`                                            | 200       |
| DELETE | `/settings/{key}`                  | Reset one setting to its default | `key`: string (path, required)                                       | -                                                   | 204       |
| GET    | `/model-catalog`                   | The model catalog                | -                                                                    | -                                                   | 200       |
| PUT    | `/model-catalog/{harness}/{model}` | Add or update a catalog entry    | `harness`: string (path, required), `model`: string (path, required) | `{ displayName, efforts, defaultEffort, enabled? }` | 200       |
| DELETE | `/model-catalog/{harness}/{model}` | Remove a catalog entry           | `harness`: string (path, required), `model`: string (path, required) | -                                                   | 204       |

## secrets

Named secrets (values are never returned).

| Method | Path              | Summary                                       | Parameters                      | Request body | Responses |
| ------ | ----------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------ | --------- |
| GET    | `/secrets`        | List secret names (values are never returned) | -                               | -            | 200       |
| PUT    | `/secrets/{name}` | Create or replace a secret                    | `name`: string (path, required) | `{ value }`  | 200       |
| DELETE | `/secrets/{name}` | Delete a secret                               | `name`: string (path, required) | -            | 204       |

## api-keys

Keys for other applications and the MCP server.

| Method | Path             | Summary                                    | Parameters                    | Request body         | Responses |
| ------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------- | -------------------- | --------- |
| GET    | `/api-keys`      | List API keys                              | -                             | -                    | 200       |
| POST   | `/api-keys`      | Create an API key; the token is shown once | -                             | `{ label, scopes? }` | 201       |
| DELETE | `/api-keys/{id}` | Revoke an API key                          | `id`: string (path, required) | -                    | 204       |

## events

The inbound event bus.

| Method | Path      | Summary                                                 | Parameters                                                                 | Request body                     | Responses |
| ------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------- |
| GET    | `/events` | Stored inbound events, newest first                     | `type`: string (query), `before`: string (query), `limit`: integer (query) | -                                | 200       |
| POST   | `/events` | Publish an inbound event; fires matching event triggers | -                                                                          | `{ type, payload?, dedupeKey? }` | 202       |

## triggers

Schedules, webhook endpoints, and the public /hooks receiver.

| Method | Path                   | Summary                                                                      | Parameters                       | Request body | Responses |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------ | --------- |
| GET    | `/loops/{id}/triggers` | Schedules, webhook endpoints, and armed poll triggers of a loop              | `id`: string (path, required)    | -            | 200       |
| POST   | `/hooks/{token}`       | Signed webhook receiver (public; HMAC, timestamp window, dedupe, rate limit) | `token`: string (path, required) | -            | 202       |
